_about: UI-E2E-1: the VITE_* environment the ui-e2e build is made with (.github/workflows/ui-e2e.yml exports every key of `env`). Read support/serveBuild.ts for why the suite builds locally instead of testing the Vercel Preview.
_productionFlags: The feature flags match Vercel PRODUCTION (Vercel's Preview environment does not carry them). Source for each: the handoff record of when it was switched on in production (handoff/CURRENT_STATE.md, SESSION_LOG.md). When a VITE_* flag is switched on or off in Vercel Production, change it here in the same PR, or the suite tests a page students do not see. Kill switches (*_DISABLED) are unset in production and stay unset here.
_hermeticFirebase: The VITE_FIREBASE_* values are DELIBERATELY FAKE. Production's web config is not copied into the repo (CLAUDE.md section 7: no API keys in source files). A configured-but-fake Firebase app is what the free Answer Checker needs to request an App Check token; support/network.ts answers that request with a stub token, and blocks every other Google host, so these values never reach a real Firebase project. Signed out, the pages make no other Firebase call.
